answer.summary: All AppTest and CustomDomainHttpIsolationTest cases fail because the Spring context does not start: a circular bean dependency involving workflowService (workflowService -> workflowEndService -> notificationEventService -> scenarioNotificationEventHandler -> exerciseService -> workflowService). The first failure is deterministic and repeats on every context load, so it is not a flake. Caveat: the touched-files list only shows WorkflowServiceTest.java, so the cycle may come from main code not listed here or may predate this branch. Check whether the PR added a constructor dependency in the workflow or exercise services.
